style.styleTitle: Homcom 5ft Artificial Christmas Tree With Automatic Open Design
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Your Christmas done extra special and beautiful this year - celebrate the season with this artificial tree from HOMCOM. It s covered in snow flecks, with a variety of red berries and pinecones scattered all over. 5ft size is suitable for medium and large rooms. Top branch for your star or angel topper. Comes complete with a removable base, keeping the tree steady and stable.</p><ul><li>408 plastic branch tips for a full, life-like look;</li><li>Large base for balance, is removable;</li><li>Design filled with berries and pine cones for a luxurious and on-season look;</li><li>Top branch for your star/angel;</li><li>Flame retardant for safety (still, do not leave near direct heat sources);</li><li>Suggested 15-20 minutes spent to spread out the branches;</li><li>Tree Color: Green;</li><li>Materials: PVC, Steel;</li><li>Overall Dimension: F53 x 150H cm;</li><li>Tree Height: 5FT;</li><li>Tip count: 408;</li><li>Item Label: 830-382</li></ul>
